# Command-line reference

The helper opens when no command is given. These options are generated from the same argparse parser used by the CLI.

```text
usage: mt2fw [-h] {new,check,pack,doctor,install,uninstall,add} ...

positional arguments:
  {new,check,pack,doctor,install,uninstall,add}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
```

## new

```text
usage: mt2fw new [-h] [--template {hello,inspector,scenery,native}]
                 id directory

positional arguments:
  id
  directory

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --template {hello,inspector,scenery,native}
```

## check

```text
usage: mt2fw check [-h] directory

positional arguments:
  directory

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
```

## pack

```text
usage: mt2fw pack [-h] directory output

positional arguments:
  directory
  output

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
```

## doctor

```text
usage: mt2fw doctor [-h] [--game GAME] [--profile PROFILE]

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --game GAME
  --profile PROFILE
```

## install

```text
usage: mt2fw install [-h] [--profile PROFILE] package game

positional arguments:
  package
  game

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --profile PROFILE
```

## uninstall

```text
usage: mt2fw uninstall [-h] game

positional arguments:
  game

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
```

## add

```text
usage: mt2fw add [-h] archive profile

positional arguments:
  archive
  profile

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit
```

`new` creates a complete project. `check` validates it without executing scripts. `pack` writes an archive outside its source. `doctor` reads game/profile diagnostics. Installation commands preserve original game data and require the target game to be closed.
